name: nikon-camera-bridge
description: Monorepo: Nikon USB bridge core, control API, MF virtual camera adapter, and desktop shell
author: AMDphreak

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @nikon-camera-bridge/core run build && pnpm --filter @nikon-camera-bridge/api run build && pnpm --filter @nikon-camera-bridge/video run build
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @nikon-camera-bridge/core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @nikon-camera-bridge/api run typecheck && pnpm --filter @nikon-camera-bridge/video run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @nikon-camera-bridge/desktop run build
